claimBoundary: The experiment holds decoded source RGB, encoder quality, Huffman optimization and progressive mode constant while changing only chroma sampling geometry. 4:2:2 introduces horizontal 2x reconstruction, 4:4:0 introduces vertical 2x reconstruction, and 4:2:0 introduces both axes.

ImageCraft/ImageIO packed RGBA8 is compared against one-shot pinned libjpeg-turbo RGB without post-hoc tolerances. Geometry and opaque alpha are hard invariants; max-code, MAE, RMSE/PSNR and exact-pixel fractions are observations.

The 4:4:0 branch is intentionally included as an axis-isolation mechanism even though it is less common in ordinary JPEG content. A large vertical-only residual is evidence about reconstruction-axis policy, not a claim that either backend is perceptually superior.
